messages:
aisha: Quick heads-up — ClearWell Health POC goes live next Tue. They want to validate a new model variant (Nightingale-16B-compact) for convo + long-context embeddings. Customer needs PHI-safe setup. Questions: is Nightingale in our catalog? what's required for onboarding a compact/quantized variant? pricing ballpark for ~100M gen tokens + 5M embed tokens/mo? attaching sec questionnaire they sent.

tom: Not seeing Nightingale-16B-compact in our public catalog today. We can onboard but need a few things from the customer: model artifact (HF or S3), tokenizer files, sample workloads (typical prompts + sequences), and expected max context length. Also need to know target latency SLOs so we can recommend Dedicated vs hosted.

jenny: From infra/ML side — compact variant suggests we should supply quantized builds (q4_k or q5_k?). If they care about long context (>=32k) we need to verify KV cache placement and whether the model uses sliding windows. Kernel-wise, Nightingale looks like a standard transformer but we should run a quick perf sweep on A100 + H100 shapes.

jenny: Also: run tokenizer->vocab sanity check. If tokenizer differs from existing catalog models we may need a small adapter step. Recommend customer provide ~1000 representative prompts for eval.

marco: Security checklist: PHI = we require Private deployment (VPC) or Dedicated with SOC2 + BAA. KMS/HSM for key management, audit logging enabled, and network isolation. Please share the security questionnaire — I’ll start filling items. We’ll need their DPO contact and data flow diagram.

ryan: Pricing note: for hosted API 100M gen tokens + 5M embed tokens is going to be expensive at full list rates. Two practical options: (1) committed Dedicated capacity with monthly commit (we can model cost if they share expected qps/seq len), or (2) mixed routing: embeddings to hosted, generation to dedicated for heavy workloads. I can sketch a provisional quote if someone shares expected peak rps and avg seq length.

deploy-bot: build-check — model-upload pipeline: queued, awaiting artifact verification.

tom: Onboarding steps I propose: 1) Get artifacts + tokenizer + sample prompts. 2) Run tokenizer & fp32 correctness tests. 3) Produce quantization candidates and run perf sweep. 4) Run safety/eval suite and quality thresholds (precision on medical extraction). 5) If PHI -> recommend Private/Dedicated + KMS. 6) Finalize pricing & SLA, then schedule canary.

aisha: Good list. I have the sec questionnaire already — uploading it to the deal doc. I’ll ping ClearWell to provide artifacts and a 1k prompt set. They asked about an expected timeline — can we do model validation in 5 business days once we have artifacts?

jenny: 5 business days is doable for basic perf + tokenizer checks if artifacts are clean. Full safety/quality eval might take 2 more days depending on edge cases. If they need 32k context verification that adds runtime for kernel tuning — call that +3 days.

marco: I'll start the security pre-check today. For BAA + PHI we need exec sponsor review. If they want Private deployment, legal will need 2–3 weeks for contract addendum. Flagging as potential blocker for timeline.

ryan: For quoting: can you ask them for monthly peak concurrent streams and avg token/response? Even a 95th percentile tokens-per-minute number helps. I’ll produce a committed vs hosted cost comparison once we have that.

aisha: Will do — asking for artifacts + perf numbers now. Also, can someone drop a short command snippet for the team to run tokenizer check? I’ll include it in the onboarding checklist I send them.

tom: Sure — quick check we run locally:
```
# verify tokenizer roundtrip
python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path/to/tokenizer'); s='\n'.join(open('samples.txt').read().splitlines()[:100]); ids=t(s)['input_ids']; print(len(ids))"
```
That plus a few edge cases (weird unicode, long sequences).

jenny: Also run a minimal forward pass smoke test:
```
# smoke forward
python -c "import torch; from model_loader import load; m=load('path/to/model'); x=torch.randint(0,32000,(1,512)); print(m(x).shape)"
```
Will catch shape mismatch / missing weights.

aisha: Perfect — sending checklist.

marco: One more security ask: if they plan to use embeddings for indexing PHI, we require encrypted-at-rest indices and strict access controls. Add that to the doc.

aisha: noted. final ask — can someone own the initial perf sweep (kernel/quantization candidates)? If jenny can take it, I’ll loop in the customer for artifact transfer.

jenny: I can own perf sweep. Please FTP or S3 link, pref pre-signed with read-only. I’ll allocate a small test job and post results here.

ryan: I’ll draft a pricing sketch after the sample prompts and peak numbers arrive.

aisha: thanks team. I’ll update the deal doc and schedule a sync with ClearWell for Fri.

deploy-bot: model-upload: artifact verified, checksum OK.
